acceptance.fix_en: The page lists 27 jobs (LTA VRLS Enquiry/Result, MHA Enquiry/Result, Toppan Generate Letters/Acknowledgement Files, ENA Reminder and Retry, Job Report, DataHive UEN/FIN, Batch Sync, Sync Transaction Data, Daily/Monthly Paid and Exception report e-mails, Daily RIP Hirer/Driver report, Furnish Sync, HST monthly, Auto Revival, Combined REP Upload, Combined CES Upload and Download, Unclaimed Report, vHub end-day/download/summary report), each with a 'Trigger Cron' button. There is no REP download row. In the prod properties of the cron tier, Toppan SFTP upload (sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan), SMTP (email.enableSmtp=false) and SMS (sms.enable=false) are switched off; which triggers are affected was not traced and the real server values cannot be verified from the repo.

acceptance.claim: A click sends POST cron/<job>/trigger to the staff API, which forwards it to the cron tier (CronProxyController/CronProxyService). The page shows 'Triggered' also when the proxy answers 200/202 or times out, so 'Triggered' does not prove the job started.
acceptance.missing: Forwarding proved: CronProxyController.java has a live @PostMapping for each of the 27 endpoints, each calls a CronProxyService method that ends in proxyCronJob (CronProxyService.java:88-136). Wording is imprecise: the UI treats HTTP 200, 202, 408/502/503/504/524, no response, or an exception as 'triggered' (lines 279-285); the proxy itself turns a read timeout into HTTP 200 (CronProxyService.java:116-126) and returns 500 when the cron tier is unreachable (line 128-134), which the page shows as 'Error triggering'. Only the 13 jobs without a status key show the word 'Triggered' (badge); the 14 others show 'Running'. Cron-tier target controllers exist for all proxied paths (checked by grep, not every body).
acceptance.fix_en: A click sends POST cron/<job>/trigger to the staff API, which forwards it to the cron tier (CronProxyController/CronProxyService). The page treats HTTP 200, 202, gateway timeouts (408, 502, 503, 504, 524) and no response as 'triggered' (a job without a status key then shows a 'Triggered' badge, a job with a status key shows Running), so this does not prove the job started; a 4xx/5xx answer shows 'Error triggering'.

acceptance.claim: For the 14 jobs that have a status key, the page polls POST cron/job-status?key=<key> and shows Running with elapsed time, Completed or Failed, with a dismiss button. The other 13 jobs show only a 30-second 'Triggered' badge.
acceptance.missing: 14 keys = STATUS_ENDPOINT_MAP lines 86-99; 30 s = line 102 + 312-317; poll every 5 s line 255/103, 1 h timeout line 104. Differences: (a) the badge label for success is 'Done', not 'Completed' (line 116); (b) the dismiss button exists only for finished states (line 122), not while Running; (c) the cron tier answers 'R' (Running) when no ocms_batch_job row exists yet (CronJobStatusController.java:171-176) so Running does not prove the job started; (d) after 3 consecutive poll errors the badge turns Failed 'Status unavailable' (lines 243-250) although the job may have finished; (e) all 14 keys are in the cron-tier allowlist (CronJobStatusController.java:125-139).
acceptance.fix_en: For the 14 jobs that have a status key, the page polls POST cron/job-status?key=<key> every 5 seconds (1 hour timeout) and shows Running with elapsed time, then Done or Failed; the dismiss button appears when the state is finished. The other 13 jobs show only a 30-second 'Triggered' badge.
